name: zammad-pp-mcp
description: Every Zammad ticket, article, and Knowledge Base operation as one CLI and MCP server  -  plus a team-management layer (agent load, customer health, aging backlog, escalation triage, churn risk, feedback mining) the Zammad API can't answer in a single call.

zammad_api_token.title: ZAMMAD_API_TOKEN
zammad_api_token.description: Sets ZAMMAD_API_TOKEN for the Zammad MCP server.

zammad_url.title: Zammad instance URL
zammad_url.description: Root URL of your Zammad instance, e.g. https://support.example.com. The CLI appends /api/v1 itself. Without it the CLI points at a placeholder host that is not your instance.

zammad_base_url.title: Zammad API base URL
zammad_base_url.description: Explicit full API base, e.g. https://support.example.com/api/v1. Overrides the instance URL above. Leave blank unless your instance serves the API somewhere non-standard.
